name: Aggressive Power Attack (Combat)
body:
You sacrifice defense for offensive power.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, base attack bonus +4

Benefit: When using Power Attack, you can choose to take a penalty to your armor class instead of your attack bonus.

Normal: You take penalties to all melee attacks and combat maneuvers in exchange for causing more damage.
